articles.title: Watch: LE SSERAFIM Is Ready To Party In 1st Comeback Teasers For “Time To Celebrate”
articles.description: LE SSERAFIM has entered a festive new era! On April 8 KST, LE SSERAFIM released their first teasers for their upcoming comeback later this month. In addition to a playful video of the members having fun, LE SSERAFIM also posted a teaser image announcing, “It’s Time To Celebrate. LE SSERAFIM will celebrate and congratulate you… Continue reading Watch: LE SSERAFIM Is Ready To Party In 1st Comeback Teasers For “Time To Celebrate” The post Watch: LE SSERAFIM Is Ready To Party In 1st Comeback Teasers
articles.summary: LE SSERAFIM released their first comeback teasers on April 8 KST for their upcoming release titled "Time To Celebrate," featuring a playful video and teaser image with a festive theme.
articles.author: E Cha
